//: Copy to appsettings.{Environment}.Local.json (Development, Staging) or appsettings.Local.json (Production) and fill in the real values. Those files are gitignored and override the ***REMOVED*** placeholders in the tracked appsettings files. Include only the keys you need.

LocalLogin.//: Hosts that must never contact PIS (the MonsterASP test site): set PIS.Disabled and Enabled to true and list each test account's hash from Helpers.LocalPassword.Hash.

SignIn.//: Optional. List domains such as "dpwh.gov.ph" to allow sign-in only from computers whose name (reverse DNS of their IP) is under one of them. Leave empty for no restriction. Check first that the office computers' IPs resolve to such names on this server, or no one can sign in.
